Joins `@babulvaibhav/egradx-audit` to `@babulvaibhav/egradx-auth`, as the Java `egradx-audit-auth` joins the Java libraries.

| Export | What it is |
|---|---|
| `auditWithAuth(auth)` | Adds the audit authorities (`egradx.audit.read`, `egradx.audit.platform.read`) to auth's catalog. Returns the `actors` and `names` options for `createAuditor`. |
| `authAuditActors` | Who is calling the audit endpoints, and with which scope, from the signed-in caller. |
| `authAuditNames(auth)` | The names of the people and organizations in a record. |
| `auditAuthorityContributor` | The authorities alone. |

```ts
const auditor = createAuditor({ prisma, ...auditWithAuth(auth) });
```

## Variables

### auditAuthorityContributor

```ts
const auditAuthorityContributor: EgradxAuthorityContributor;
```

egradx-audit's authorities, contributed to egradx-auth's catalog: reading one's organization's trail
is an organization admin's; reading every organization's, the platform's alone. As Java's
EgradxAuditAuthorityContributor.

***

### authAuditActors

```ts
const authAuditActors: AuditActorResolver;
```

Who is signed in to the current request, for the audit trail: egradx-auth's resolved caller.

## Functions

### auditWithAuth()

```ts
function auditWithAuth(auth): Pick<AuditorOptions, "actors" | "names">;
```

Connects egradx-audit to egradx-auth, as Java's egradx-audit-auth does by being on the classpath:
contributes the audit authorities (call before auth.start()) and returns the auditor options that
say who acted and name the people on records.

  const auditor = createAuditor({ prisma, ...auditWithAuth(auth) });

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `auth` | [`Auth`](/docs/reference/node/egradx-sdk#auth) |

#### Returns

`Pick`\<[`AuditorOptions`](/docs/reference/node/egradx-sdk#auditoroptions), `"actors"` \| `"names"`\>

***
